proof-narrative-lean-equiv.evidence: [sidecar review 2026-11-15, issue #8030] **Statement is internally inconsistent.** Item 1 says ρ₃: B₃ → Aut(V^⊗3) is faithful; item 2 says its image is Dic₃, order 12. B₃ is infinite, so a faithful image cannot be finite. Counterexample to item 2 in a Descartes universe (real q > 1): ρ₃(σ₁) has eigenvalue q with \ | q\ | ≠1, so it has infinite order and the image is infinite. "Image in SU(2)" of an 8-dim rep is not defined. Lean (`QOU/Archimedean/archimedean_braid_structure.lean:49`) takes `himg : G ≃* Dic3` as a hypothesis and concludes `card G = 12`: a transport of cardinality, with the braid group, ρ₃, faithfulness and item 3 absent. prf: "faithfulness follows from distinct eigenvalues q, −q⁻¹" is a non-sequitur (distinct eigenvalues of one generator say nothing about the kernel). Item 3: the setwise stabiliser in S₅ of a pair of coordinates is S₂×S₃ (order 12), not S₃.
